name: Shem
summary: One of Noah's three sons, who was saved with his family in the ark. Noah praised the LORD as Shem's God, and Shem's family line led down to Abram.

key_moments.title: Saved in the Ark
key_moments.description: Shem went into the ark with his father Noah, his mother, his brothers Ham and Japheth, and their wives.

key_moments.title: Covers His Father
key_moments.description: Noah drank wine from his vineyard and lay uncovered in his tent, and Ham saw him and told his brothers. Shem and Japheth laid a garment on their shoulders, walked in backward and covered their father without looking at him.

key_moments.title: Blessed by Noah
key_moments.description: When Noah woke and learned what his youngest son had done, he cursed Canaan. He blessed the LORD as the God of Shem and said Canaan would be Shem's servant.
